title: Solar Power Just Passed Coal In America
source: U.S. cumulative installed capacity, gigawatts. Solar (utility-scale): 76 GW (2019) and 141 GW (2022), 177 GW (2023), 236 GW (2024) -- SEIA/Wood Mackenzie 'Solar Market Insight' Year-in-Review reports; 2020 and 2026 figures are straight-line estimates between confirmed SEIA annual totals, not independently reported. Coal (net summer capacity): 223 GW (2020) and 178.4 GW (2023) -- EIA 'Today in Energy'; 163.4 GW (early 2026) -- EIA data as reported by Energy Central, the point at which cumulative solar capacity overtook coal capacity for the first time; 2019 and 2022 figures are straight-line estimates between confirmed EIA totals.
